_comment: Framed view for capturing a routed AFG signal end-to-end. Fast timebase so a FULL record fills in milliseconds (far under the capture settle) and shows several complete cycles - unlike bench_full's 4 s/div, where a 40 s record only partly fills. Pair with a ~1 kHz AFG signal. CH1/CH2 2.5 V/div DC 1 MOhm, NO bandwidth key (so a 70 MHz MSO24 does not clamp it), 0.5 ms/div (5 ms window ~ 5 cycles at 1 kHz), trigger CH1 @ 5 V (midpoint of a 0-10 V signal), AUTO sweep. WINDOW: pass duration_s=0.005 to configure_scope for this test (0.005 s total = 0.0005 s/div x 10).
name: signal_view
